arpeggios.tip: Over the ii chord, target A (the 3rd of F7) in the next bar.
Land on D (the 3rd of Bbmaj7) to make the ii–V–I resolution clear.
Use A or F to connect smoothly into the Ebmaj7 arpeggio.
D resolves down naturally to C, the 3rd of Am7b5.
Emphasize Eb (the b5), then resolve by semitone into D7 chord tones.
Optional tension: add Eb (b9) before resolving to Gm7.
Resolve on G, Bb, or D; Gm6 (G Bb D E) is an optional minor-key color.
